passages.why: The passage reproduces the statutory text of the efficiency defence in a voting context but does not apply it to a specific set of facts with a visible outcome.

passages.label: recites
passages.quote: Gemäss Art. 5 Abs. 2 lit. a und lit. b KG sind Wettbewerbsabreden durch Gründe der wirtschaftlichen Effizienz gerechtfertigt, wenn sie (1) notwendig sind, (2) um die Herstellungs- oder Vertriebskosten zu senken, Produkte ode
passages.why: The court restates the rule, but the application (which the lower court performed and the appellant did not contest) is not visible in this fragment.

passages.label: recites
passages.why: The passage states the presumption can be rebutted and moves to market definition, without applying the rule to a visible consequence.

passages.label: recites
passages.why: The passage explains in general how to determine if competition is eliminated, without applying the rule to the specific case with a visible consequence.

passages.label: unrelated
passages.why: The passage applies the presumption to horizontal price agreements under Art. 5(3)(a) KG, not to vertical agreements as specified in the proposition.

passages.label: recites
passages.why: The passage restates the presumption for horizontal price agreements and states the decisive factor, but applies it to a horizontal context, and no legal consequence is visible in the passage itself.

passages.label: partial
passages.quote: Im Sinne von Art. 5 Abs. 3 und 1 KG war der wirksame Wettbewerb daher vermutungsweise beseitigt.
passages.why: The passage finds the presumption applies to a horizontal agreement with Gebietsschutz and Preisabsprachen, but the proposition addresses vertical agreements, so only part of the rule (price-fixing) is used in a different context.

passages.label: recites
passages.why: The passage states the presumption is fulfilled but cuts off before the subsumption and consequence are visible.

passages.label: contradicts
passages.quote: Die gesetzliche Vermutung von Art. 5 Abs. 3 KG erfasst nur horizontale Wettbewerbsabreden
passages.why: The passage explicitly states the presumption does not apply to vertical agreements, contradicting the proposition that it does.

passages.label: recites
passages.why: The passage recites the legal consequence of the fulfilled presumption and explains it can be rebutted, without applying it to a visible consequence in the passage.
